systemConfiguration.title: System Configuration
systemConfiguration.publicEndpointsDescription: Toggle whether demo and redeem endpoints are accessible without authentication.
systemConfiguration.contentDisplayDescription: Configure how content is displayed to end users.
systemConfiguration.hideEmptyEpisodesDescription: Hide episodes that do not have a video file assigned. Useful when importing series from TMDB.
systemConfiguration.publicDemoDescription: Allow creating demo accounts without authentication.
systemConfiguration.publicRedeemDescription: Allow redeeming gift codes without authentication.
systemConfiguration.creditDescription: Configure default device limits and credit rates for user creation
systemConfiguration.dbToolsDescription: Import or export data safely between legacy and PostgreSQL formats.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsLegacyDescription: Import a legacy `.db` file. This is intended for old installations.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsLegacyHint: Use this option only for legacy migrations. Prefer SQL import/export for regular backups.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsImportPartial: Import completed with some warnings. Review the logs.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsExportDescription: Download a full SQL backup from the current PostgreSQL database.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsImportNewDescription: Import a `.sql` backup into the current database.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsImportWarning: Import operations can modify large amounts of data. Always keep a backup before continuing.
systemConfiguration.dbToolsImportStatusHint: Track current and recent import operations.

forms.defaultDevicesHelp: Default number of devices for new users
forms.creditPerExtraDeviceHelp: Credits charged for each device above default
forms.credit3DevicesHelp: Credits deducted when creating a user with 3 devices
forms.credit5DevicesHelp: Credits deducted when creating a user with 5 devices
forms.tmdbDescription: Configure TMDB API integration for automatic content metadata
forms.tmdbApiKeyHelp: Get your API key from TMDB API Settings
forms.tmdbEnabledDescription: Toggle TMDB metadata fetching for the control panel.
forms.tmdbLanguageHelp: Language for movie titles, descriptions, and metadata from TMDB
forms.tmdbPreferredFormatHelp: Choose the preferred format for TMDB artwork in offline mode
forms.tmdbModeDescription: Choose whether to fetch metadata directly from TMDB or from your local metadata cache.
forms.tmdbMetadataPathHelp: Relative path on the server where offline TMDB metadata and images are stored (default: metadata).
forms.tmdbOfflineHint: Offline mode will serve descriptions and artwork from the metadata folder. Make sure the folder is synchronized with up-to-date TMDB exports.
forms.loginBackdropsDescription: Customize the login hero background image wall.
forms.loginBackdropsHelp: Comma or newline separated list of URLs or /backdrops/* paths. Leave empty to use the default local assets.
forms.paymentsDescription: Configure your Stripe payment keys. Secrets are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM.
forms.serverConfigDescription: These settings affect how the backend generates URLs and serves content.
forms.publicBaseUrlHelp: Used for webhook URLs, email links, and API responses. Changes take effect immediately.
forms.noStripeKeyDescription: Payment features (credits purchase, subscriptions) will not work until you configure a Stripe secret key above or via the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY environment variable.
